what: Text forms word by word as if an AI were generating it — each word stands up from blur 8px·transparent·20% below in .5s expo.out, and the next word follows after a random .03~.12s (.22s extra after commas and periods). An accent-color cursor bar follows the word just set and, when finished, blinks four times at a 1.1s tempo. When tokens·ms are given, that element counts words × 1.33 tokens along with the elapsed ms.

options.start: If event, fires fx:play on the element (delay via detail.delay) — default is right on attach
options.pause: Extra pause after commas and periods (s), default .22
options.tokens: Element CSS for the token count (word i gets round((i+1)×1.33))
options.ms: Element CSS to write the elapsed time (ms) into

use:
A second line written word by word.
